summary.name: SitePatent
summary.one_liner: SitePatent is a curated discovery directory where newly launched startups, SaaS tools and indie products are screened and listed by category, with a free read-only MCP server for AI assistants.
use_cases: Getting a new startup or SaaS product discovered
Finding newly launched tools by category
Giving AI assistants access to directory listings via MCP
Finding alternatives to a listed product
Earning a trusted backlink for a website
summary.what_it_does: SitePatent is a directory of newly launched startups, SaaS tools and indie products, with each listing screened and organized by category. Listings are sorted by recency, with paid listings featured at the top. Free listings get a public profile, while paid one-time tiers add category pins, homepage placement and social announcements. The page also describes a read-only remote MCP server at sitepatent.com/api/mcp (per the listing) that lets AI assistants search listings, read full profiles and find alternatives, with no API key.
notable: Curated listings: each submission is screened before going live
Read-only remote MCP server for AI assistants, no API key needed (per listing)
One-time paid tiers with no subscription; bulk credit packs available
Free listings get a public profile
caveats: Paid tiers required for featured placement, homepage pins and badges
Free listings are shown as Unverified and go live at least 7 days after submission
Rejected listings refund credits, but prices are per tier and bulk credit packs are required for multi-launch use
